pairs: Et anno centesimo sexagesimo,

For he said,

et obsides, qui erant in arce,

all around, with square stones, as a fortification.

Then the foreigners,
qui erant in munitionibus quas Bacchides ædificaverat:
who were in the fortifications that Bacchides had built, fled away.
et reliquit unusquisque locum suum,

et abiit in terram suam:
and departed into his own land.
tantum in Bethsura remanserunt aliqui ex his qui reliquerant legem

et præcepta Dei:
who had forsaken the law and the precepts of God.
erat enim hæc eis ad refugium.

et narraverunt ei prælia,

and the hardships that they had endured.
et ait:
And he said:
Numquid inveniemus aliquem virum talem?

et nunc faciemus eum amicum,
And so now,
et socium nostrum.
let us make him our friend and our associate.”
Et scripsit epistolam,
And so, he wrote a letter,
et misit ei secundum hæc verba,
and he sent it to him, according to these words,
dicens:
saying:
Rex Alexander fratri Jonathæ salutem.
“King Alexander to his brother, Jonathan: greetings.
Audivimus de te quod vir potens sis viribus,
We have heard of you, that you are a man of power and strength,
et aptus es ut sis amicus noster:
and that you are fit to be our friend.
et nunc constituimus te hodie summum sacerdotem gentis tuæ,
And so now, on this day, we appoint that you be high priest of your people,
et ut amicus voceris regis (et misit ei purpuram,
and that you be called the king’s friend, (and he sent him a purple robe,

and that you keep friendship with us.”
Et induit se Jonathas stola sancta septimo mense,
Then Jonathan clothed himself with the holy vestment, in the seventh month,
anno centesimo sexagesimo,
in the one hundred and sixtieth year,
in die solemni scenopegiæ:
on the solemn day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
et congregavit exercitum,
And he gathered together an army,
et fecit arma copiosa.
and he made an abundance of weapons.

And Demetrius heard these words,
et contristatus est nimis,
and he was exceedingly sorrowful,
et ait:
and he said:
Quid hoc fecimus,

quod præoccupavit nos Alexander apprehendere amicitiam Judæorum ad munimen sui?
that Alexander has gone before us to obtain the friendship of the Jews to strengthen himself?
scribam et ego illis verba deprecatoria,
I also will write to them words of petition,
et dignitates,
and offer positions of rank
et dona,
and gifts,
ut sint mecum in adjutorium.
so that they may act in assistance to me.”
Et scripsit eis in hæc verba:
And he wrote to them in these words:
Rex Demetrius genti Judæorum salutem.
“King Demetrius to the nation of the Jews: greetings.
Quoniam servastis ad nos pactum,
Since you have kept the peace with us,
et mansistis in amicitia nostra,
and have remained in our friendship,
et non accessistis ad inimicos nostros,
and have not made agreements with our enemies,
audivimus,
we have heard of this,
et gavisi sumus.
and we are glad.
Et nunc perseverate adhuc conservare ad nos fidem,
And so now, persevere still to remain faithful to us,
et retribuemus vobis bona pro his quæ fecistis nobiscum:
and we will reward you with good things for what you have done for us.
et remittemus vobis præstationes multas,
And we will repay you for your many expenses,
et dabimus vobis donationes.
and we will give you gifts.
Et nunc absolvo vos et omnes Judæos a tributis, et pretia salis indulgeo, et coronas remitto, et tertias seminis:

et dimidiam partem fructus ligni, quod est portionis meæ,

relinquo vobis ex hodierno die,

et deinceps, ne accipiatur a terra Juda,
so that it shall not be taken from the land of Judah,

nor from the three cities that have been added to it from Samaria and Galilee,

from this day and for all time.
et Jerusalem sit sancta, et libera cum finibus suis:

and let the tenths and tributes be for itself.

And I even return authority over the stronghold,
quæ est in Jerusalem:
which is in Jerusalem,
et do eam summo sacerdoti,
and I give it to the high priest,
ut constituat in ea viros quoscumque ipse elegerit,
in order to appoint in it any such men as he will choose,
qui custodiant eam.
who will guard it.

relinquo liberam gratis,

ut omnes a tributis solvantur, etiam pecorum suorum.

Et omnes dies solemnes,
And all the days of solemnities,
et sabbata,
and the Sabbaths,
et neomeniæ,
and the new moons,
et dies decreti,
and the decreed days,
et tres dies ante diem solemnem,
and the three days before the solemn day,
et tres dies post diem solemnem,
and three days after the solemn day,
sint omnes immunitatis et remissionis omnibus Judæis,
shall all be days of immunity
qui sunt in regno meo:
and remission for all the Jews who are in my kingdom.
et nemo habebit potestatem agere aliquid,

or to incite any plots, against any of them, in all cases.

et dabuntur illis copiæ ut oportet omnibus exercitibus regis,

et ex eis ordinabuntur qui sint in munitionibus regis magni:

et ex his constituentur super negotia regni,

Ptolemais and its confines,
quas dedi donum sanctis qui sunt in Jerusalem,

for the necessary expenses of the holy things.

from what belongs to me.
et omne quod reliquum fuerit,

they will give it to the works of the house.

and this will belong to the priests who perform the ministry.

or in any of its parts,
obnoxii regi in omni negotio dimittantur,
being liable before the king in any matter, let them be released,

and all that is theirs in my kingdom, let them have it freely.

the expenses shall be given from the king’s revenues.
et ad exstruendos muros Jerusalem,

sumptus dabuntur de ratione regis,

as also for the building of the walls in Judea.”

So when Jonathan
non crediderunt eis,

dicens: Felix dies, in qua reversus es ad terram patrum tuorum,

sed occurre mihi Ptolemaidam,

and he drew near to Jamnia.

and disgrace,

descende ad nos in campum,
descend to us in the plains,
et comparemus illic invicem:
and there let us contest one another.
quia mecum est virtus bellorum.

Inquire,
et disce quis sum ego,

and the others,
qui
who are auxiliaries to me,

and he sent them against the legion.
equites enim fatigati erant:

et contriti sunt ab eo,

cum his qui succensi sunt,

fere octo millia virorum.

And it happened that,
ut audivit Alexander rex sermones istos,

addidit adhuc glorificare Jonathan.
